subject: Global Flight of the Wealthy Slows Down
posts:
The rich stopping their flight isn't a sign of global peace; it's capital finding a truce with tax collectors.

Global Wealthy Flight Slows
Evidence: stable local economies, tax minimization, public systems funded

Wealthy mobility is framed as a rational quest for stability that ultimately benefits global markets and local investment.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good

Capital flight is a system of tax avoidance that shifts the fiscal burden onto citizens who cannot relocate.
Resulting Judgement: (-2.0, -1.0) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Framing tax avoidance as stability hides the systemic extraction of wealth from public infrastructure.
The migration of high-net-worth individuals is slowing down globally as tax reforms stabilize and political uncertainties in destination countries temporarily subside.

The Bright Side:
Slower migration means wealthy residents keep their local spending and business investments steady in their home countries, offering minor local economic stability.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Presented as a logical tax rate issue (Q5 HOW), it is actually a metaphysical issue of community obligation (Q1 WHO).

Bait: Economic stability.
Switch: Fiscal extraction.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between the stated ideal of capital efficiency and the reality of mobile elites avoiding local social contracts...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Elites extract value from the societies that nurtured them, leaving the middle class to pay for the infrastructure.

The Unavoidable Truth: When the super-rich pay less, everyone else pays more.

The Unavoidable Lie: That keeping billionaires happy is the only way to fund a modern state.

Alethekanon:
Mobility of capital without social reciprocity is structurally parasitic. When the wealthy treat citizenship as a menu of tax options, the social contract decays into pure extraction.

Awwthekanon:
True security isn't found in hiding our wealth. It is built when we contribute to the wellness of the communities we live in, ensuring everyone has enough to thrive.

Brothekanon:
Must be nice to just pack up your mansion and move countries because the tax rate went up one percent. Meanwhile, regular folks are just trying to afford groceries. Pay your dues, bro.

Synthesized Resolution Vector:
Blended Path: The Path of Deception — Aletheia combines Bro's groceries reality and Aww's contribution plea, finding tax avoidance leads to Greater Evil.
Final Recalculated Coordinates: (-2.0, -1.0)
